name: AIMECHATEC,Ltd.
summary: AIMECHATEC, Ltd. started in 1990 and is based in Ryugasaki, Japan. Mainly for the flat panel display industry, it designs, builds and sells equipment such as high-precision vacuum assembly systems, linear AMC module lines, QD and OLED encapsulation solutions, micro display fabrication systems, RGB inkjet printers and medical sensor forming machines.
